Who this class is for

People leave relationships. Patterns follow them.

  • The same relationship showing up again, with a different name.
  • Conversations with an ex that turn into the same argument every time.
  • Dating again and second-guessing every signal.
  • Wanting the next chapter to look different, and not knowing where to start.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

Why the same relationship keeps showing up

How patterns travel from one partner to the next, and the early signs that one is starting again.

Ending a relationship vs ending a pattern

Why leaving isn't the same as moving on, and what actually closes the loop.

Staying calm in hard conversations

Simple ways a mediator keeps conversations with an ex short, clear and focused on what matters.

Why labels keep people stuck

What changes when the focus moves from what the other person did to what comes next.

Dating again with clear eyes

What to look for, what to stop overlooking, and how to trust your own read again.

Script 1 · "The new name"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Why do so many people end up dating the same person with a different name?"

Body

"It's rarely bad luck. The patterns we never looked at come with us into the next relationship. The good news: once a pattern is visible, it's much easier to break. That's the work I've done for 15+ years."

CTA

"I'm teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass called Patterns, Not People. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab a seat."

Shot: talking to camera at your desk, on-screen text "same person, new name".

Script 2 · "Leaving vs moving on"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Leaving a relationship and leaving a pattern are two different things."

Body

"Leaving takes a decision. Leaving a pattern takes noticing how you choose, how you argue, and what you overlook. Most people only ever do the first one, and then wonder why the next chapter feels familiar."

CTA

"In my live masterclass I'll show you how to do the second one. 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up."

Shot: talking to camera, cut to two words on screen: "relationship" crossed out, "pattern" highlighted.

Script 3 · "The label"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Here's why the label on an ex can keep someone stuck."

Body

"Labels feel like answers. But they keep the whole story about the other person. The shift happens when the question changes from 'what did they do?' to 'what do I want next?' That's where the next chapter starts."

CTA

"I'll walk you through it in my live masterclass, Patterns, Not People. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: talking to camera, slow push-in, captions on.
